whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bihta Champaran Meat House,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 3.7★ ratings with over 340+ reviews in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order placement, authentic Champaran meat specialities, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bihta-champaran

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bihta Champaran Meat House team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and mobile-first menu display for your Bihta location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
